name: pane-body-composer-gap-phone
description: On a phone the breakpoint's own .body rule declares a different bottom inset; a pane with any slot below its body (a padded footer, or a flush edge footer alone) must still close its scrolling body on that surface's hairline, while a footer-less pane keeps the phone's inset.

mutation.declaration: panescaffold.module.css: (a) remove the `.body:not(:last-child)` / `.body:last-child` pair, or (b) on the phone case only, remove the phone block's `--pane-body-edge-inset` restatement
mutation.note: Measured 2026-11-11 at 390px. Removing the phone block's token restatement fails the footer-less fixture with 24.0px where the breakpoint's token declares 16px - the two-sided check is what catches a leaked desktop value. Removing the selector pair fails both docked fixtures with a 16.0px band. Restoring both passes all four.
